title: Boundary
description: The extent of a governed area over a period of time.

@type.description: Always `Boundary` - a separate, citable entity rather than a field on the jurisdiction, because boundaries change and the change matters: wards are redrawn, municipalities annex and merge, electoral districts are reapportioned. A 2022 contest was fought on the 2022 boundary, and a budget line or permit attributed to an area is anchored to the boundary in force at the time. Attaching a single current geometry to a `Jurisdiction` silently rewrites history.

name.description: A human-readable label for this boundary, e.g. 'Ward 3 (2022)'.

boundaryOf.description: The `Jurisdiction` this is the extent of.

validUntil.description: When it ceased to apply. Absent means current. A superseded boundary is retained, not deleted - it is what historical records were drawn against.

authoritative.description: Whether this is the legally definitive extent, as opposed to a published rendering of it.

identifier.description: Any scheme-qualified identifiers for this boundary beyond its `@id`.

sourceDataset.description: The `Dataset` this record was published as part of.
